messages:
Tess: FYI were starting formal planning to retire the v1 proxy/shim. Goal: remove long-term maintenance burden while giving customers a clear, instrumented migration path. Need input on routing behavior, quota translation, console UX, telemetry, and rollback thresholds.

Mike: timeline? (looking for dates)

Tess: draft timeline: playbook by 2026-05-18, staging canary 2026-05-28, production canary 2026-06-08, full ramp by 2026-07-22. Open to small adjustments.

Sasha: compatibility guarantee? Are we promising bit-for-bit parity or functional compatibility?

Tess: were offering functional compatibility with documented diffs. For customers who absolutely need legacy semantics well provide a paid escape hatch for a bounded period.

Mike: routing proposal: introduce a new policy type `legacy_proxy` that routes shimmed traffic to an isolated v2-compat pool by default. No silent routing to cheaper variants unless tenant explicitly opts in. Also allow SRE to deprioritize legacy_proxy traffic under overload.

Jay: Console requirements: show a per-tenant migration dashboard with: number of impacted routes, estimated monthly token delta, and projected cost delta if moved to the v2-compat pool. Add a persistent deprecation banner starting 45 days before hard cutoff and an admin-only fast-forward migration button.

Olivia: SDK/clients: recommend adding a soft-enforced header `X-Redwood-Client-Version` so we can segment traffic. SDKs will include a migration helper that rewrites a handful of common v1 patterns.

Sasha: telemetry events I want emitted: `v1_deprecation_notice_shown`, `v1_migration_dryrun`, `v1_migration_committed`, `v1_shim_fallback_triggered`. Also tag every shim request with `shim_version` and `migration_cohort`. Capture pre/post-token counts and model chosen.

Mike: quota translation model (proposal):
- v1_monthly_token_limit -> v2_monthly_consumption_cap
- v1_tokens_per_minute -> v2_route_rate_limit
- v1_concurrent_requests -> v2_concurrency_quota
Auto-map 1:1 where possible and flag out-of-range mappings for manual review. Admin view should show original v1 value, mapped v2 value, and a confidence score.

Jay: UX flow: when tenant clicks "Start migration" present a dry-run summary (sample responses, estimated errors, estimated cost delta). Allow staged rollout: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with telemetry gates at each step.

Tess: gating thresholds suggestion: if error rate rises >0.75% absolute or P95 latency increases >25% vs baseline for the cohort during a stage, auto-rollback and page #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/legacy-proxy -> staging 2026-05-25 01:00 UTC :rocket:

Mike: also require we log `shim_mapped_route` and `billing_route_id` on every request so billing exports remain accurate.

Sasha: alert queries Ill add: `increase(v1_shim_fallback_triggered[5m]) > 4` and `rate(v1_migration_committed_errors[5m]) > 0.007`. Will put migration cohort filters on the dashboard.

Olivia: agree on opt-out API for large customers who need extra migration time. Also SDK helper will ship with a verbose mode to surface potential transformation changes during dry-run.

Jay: admin audit log: must record who started migration, timestamps, affected routes, and the dry-run report snapshot. Also surface a link to the sample responses shown during migration.

Tess: escape hatch: keep `v1-compat-model` available but marked deprecated and priced at a premium for 9 months after deprecation start. Support can grant extensions case-by-case.

Mike: rollout checklist owners: Routing=Mike, Quotas=Sasha, Telemetry=Sasha, Console=Jay, SDK=Olivia, Playbook=Tess, CanaryOps=eng-oncall. Add runbook and rollback steps to the canary.

ci-bot: created INF-2026 ticket and linked PR #4210 (feature/legacy-proxy).

Sasha: perf note: some transforms add ~6-12ms tail latency depending on payload shape. Include that in the estimator and the dry-run summaries.

Tess: Ill draft the public playbook and ping docs/support for migration guides. If no objections in 48h well lock the timeline.

Mike: scheduling a quick runbook sync with SRE tomorrow 10am PT.

Jay: mockups for the migration panel and banner: https://figma.redwood.example/file/efgh5678 (comments added).

Olivia: noted, will start SDK PR and examples.

eng-oncall: will add automated rollback pipeline to the canary and link alert runbooks.

Tess: thanks everyone. Ill post the playbook here when ready. Speak up if you need changes to owners or timing.

Mike: :thumbsup:

Olivia: :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: CI: PR #4210 merged to staging.

Tess: closing loop for now, will follow up with the playbook post.
